page_title: BET 1-0 ESP | Betis v Espanyol 29/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+8' Alvaro Tejero (Espanyol) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
90+6' Alejandro Hernandez shows the yellow card to Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) for a heavy challenge.

90+5' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Joan Garcia pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
90+2' The corner from Alvaro Tejero (Espanyol) is intercepted by Rui Silva.
90+2' Alex Kral (Espanyol) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. Espanyol force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
90' 8 additional min. will be played.
90' Alejandro Hernandez blows for a foul after Alvaro Tejero (Espanyol) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
89' The linesman signals that Alejo Veliz (Espanyol) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Abde Ezzalzouli departs the field of play to be replaced by Assane Diao (Betis).
87' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Alvaro Aguado (Espanyol) replacing Pol Lozano.
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Carlos Romero leaves the pitch and Alejo Veliz (Espanyol) comes on.
85' 1 - 0 Goal! Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.

84' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
82' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.

81' A neat pass is well received by Pablo Fornals (Betis), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.
81' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Betis comes to nothing.
81' Vitor Roque (Betis) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
79' Manuel Pellegrini decides to make a substitution. Sergi Altimira will be replaced by Johnny Cardoso (Betis).
78' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Marc Roca.
77' Alejandro Hernandez shows a yellow card to Sergi Altimira (Betis), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
76' Betis have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

76' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. Betis will take a corner kick.
74' A yellow card for a tackle by Carlos Romero (Espanyol). Alejandro Hernandez doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
74' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his low drive towards the left post, but the keeper dives low to keep the ball out.
72' Manolo Gonzalez isn't happy on the touchline after referee Alejandro Hernandez shows him a yellow card.
72' The resulting set piece from Betis is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
71' Pere Milla (Espanyol) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
71' Irvin Cardona (Espanyol) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Alejandro Hernandez has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
69' Diego Llorente (Betis) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
68' Here is a change. Jofre is going off and Manolo Gonzalez gives the last tactical orders to Alvaro Tejero (Espanyol).
68' That's the end of the game for Walid Cheddira, who is replaced by Irvin Cardona (Espanyol).
67' Diego Llorente (Betis) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
66' Golden chance! Pablo Fornals (Betis) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the right post.
66' Pere Milla (Espanyol) takes a long run up and smacks the long-range free kick towards goal, but the defensive wall bravely blocks the effort.
64' Marc Roca (Betis) sees a yellow card from Alejandro Hernandez after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
62' Alex Kral (Espanyol) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
61' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to substitute Iker Losada and he is replaced by Pablo Fornals (Betis).
61' We are about to witness a substitution. Vitor Roque (Betis) is replacing Cedric Bakambu.
59' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
58' The corner is swung in but Espanyol can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
57' Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle. Walid Cheddira (Espanyol) commits a foul after dangerous play.
56' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
55' Javi Puado (Espanyol) is being substituted because of an injury. Manolo Gonzalez sends Pere Milla on the pitch.

54' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) displays brilliant awareness inside the six-yard box and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the middle of the target, but Joan Garcia keeps the ball out. The ball is out of play. Betis will have a chance to score from a corner.
53' Javi Puado (Espanyol) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Alejandro Hernandez blows for a foul. Betis are awarded the free kick.
53' Betis take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

52' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Joan Garcia makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the roof of the net. The ball goes behind for a corner. Betis will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
51' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
49' Walid Cheddira (Espanyol) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
48' Diego Llorente (Betis) commits a rough foul. Alejandro Hernandez stops the game and makes a call.
47' Javi Puado (Espanyol) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
45+3' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Betis, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
45+1' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) has a great chance to score from the penalty. He shoots to the right post, but Joan Garcia leaps out to thwart his attempt.
45' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) is going to take the penalty!
43' Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle for a foul after Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) hacks down one of his opponents. PENALTY to Betis! Let's see who will take responsibility.
40' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) commits a rough challenge and Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle for a foul.
38' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) controls a poor pass, breaks past an opponent then slices an effort from mid-range well wide of the right post.
36' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.

34' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.

34' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Joan Garcia pulls off a brilliant save.
33' A cross into the box from Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) is cleared.
32' Marc Roca (Betis) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
30' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
29' A lofted cross from Carlos Romero (Espanyol) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
27' The game is interrupted. Jose Gragera (Espanyol) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
26' Today's referee Alejandro Hernandez rightly decides to book Jofre (Espanyol) for his harsh tackle.

23' Natan (Betis) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Joan Garcia. This effort really didn't trouble him.
22' The resulting set piece from Betis is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
21' Iker Losada (Betis) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
18' Jofre (Espanyol) has an effort from distance but it's blocked.
13' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
12' Marash Kumbulla (Espanyol) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Alejandro Hernandez no option but to blow his whistle.
11' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Espanyol comes to nothing.
11' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Alex Kral (Espanyol). Espanyol have a corner.
8' Cedric Bakambu (Betis) tackles a bit over-zealously and Alejandro Hernandez blows for a foul.
7' Espanyol can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
6' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. Espanyol get a corner.
6' Betis failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
5' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Betis. The linesman points to the corner flag, Betis are going to take it.
3' A sweet pass inside the box gives Cedric Bakambu (Betis) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance!
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Espanyol will kick-off.
Alejandro Hernandez is the one to supervise the game today.
